aarti.tek: Victory to you, lord of Lakṣmī; victory to you, Master, lord of Lakṣmī. Master Satyanārāyaṇa, you take away the sins of the people.
aarti.pad1: On the jewel-studded throne your wondrous beauty shines. Nārada waves the lamps in worship, and the bell rings out. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You appeared for the sake of the Kali age and gave a brāhmaṇa your darśana; taking the form of an old brāhmaṇa, you made a palace of gold. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You showed grace to the poor Bhīl woodcutters; there was a king, Candracūḍa, whose misfortune you took away. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The merchant gained his heart's wish and gave up his faith; he suffered the fruit of it, and then sang the Lord's praise. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: For the sake of loving devotion you took on forms time after time; those who held to faith had their tasks fulfilled. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: A king worshipped you in the forest with the cowherd boys; Hari, compassionate to the lowly, gave him the fruit his heart desired. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: An offering of one and a quarter measures is made to you, with bananas and dried fruits; with incense, lamps and tulasī, Satyadeva is pleased. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa, says Śivānanda Svāmī, he gains the fruit the heart desires. ॥8॥
